def transform(grid):
    # The demonstrated pattern in the lower-right compartment is repeated
    # across the compartment grid, mirrored horizontally/vertically as needed.
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 9]
    cs = [c for c in range(W) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(H)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 9]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [H], [-1] + cs + [W]
    ri, ci = len(rb)-2, len(cb)-2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        a,b=rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            x,y=cb[j]+1,cb[j+1]
            for r in range(a,b):

def transform(grid):
    # Tile the non-background motif from below the horizontal divider into
    # each quadrant formed by the 5-colored divider(s); mirror across edges.
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hbar = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    vbars = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(H))]
    # The pattern is repeated in the corresponding regions on either side
    # of dividers. Derive source motif from bottom-right block.
    rb = [r for r in range(H) if all(v == 5 for v in grid[r])]
    cb = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(H))]
    rowcuts = [-1] + rb + [H]
    colcuts = [-1] + cb + [W]
    blocks = [(rowcuts[i]+1,rowcuts[i+1],colcuts[j]+1,colcuts[j+1])
              for i in range(len(rowcuts)-1) for j in range(len(colcuts)-1)]
    # choose block with most non-background content as source
    src = max(blocks, key=lambda b: sum(x != 9 for row in grid[b[0]:b[1]] for x in row[b[2]:b[3]]))
